title: Introduce heuristic variant weighting and release annotator
author: Asha Patel
release_notes: Adds a heuristic-driven variant weighting engine to improve model onboarding prioritization and a release annotator that drafts concise changelog entries based on onboarding deltas and perf signals. Includes perf-sampling hooks and configuration flags for opt-in production rollout.
description: Context: onboarding throughput has been noisy for wide-variant uploads and our changelog generation frequently misses concise, actionable blurbing when multiple variant-level changes are batched. This PR introduces two complementary systems: 1) a heuristic variant weighting engine that scores incoming variants using historical traffic patterns, performance deltas, and license/size heuristics to surface a prioritized sampling queue for profiling and release candidate promotion; 2) a release annotator service that consumes the onboarding delta (metadata changes, profile diffs, and perf sample summaries) and auto-drafts a short, structured changelog snippet with severity and rollout suggestions. Design highlights: weighting is configurable by policy with fallbacks (size/latency/affordance weight slices), weighting outputs are stored as a transient priority key in the intake pipeline, and the annotator uses templated heuristics to produce one-line titles + 2-3 bullet highlights. Safety: annotator is opt-in and drafts are created as PR comments and in the release-drafts queue; we added guardrails to prevent leaking internal perf numbers (redacts sample IDs) and a confidence score accompanies every auto-draft. Deployment plan: feature flag rollout (staged by organization tier), canary to 5% of onboarding traffic, full opt-in after two weeks of monitoring. Backwards compatibility: default behavior preserves existing onboarding pipeline unless feature flag enabled. Testing: unit tests for scoring math, integration tests exercising the intake -> annotator pipeline with synthetic profiles, and an end-to-end smoke test validating a drafted changelog for a multi-variant upload. Impact: expected to reduce manual curation time for release notes, accelerate promotion of high-impact variants to staged rollouts, and improve sampling efficiency for perf jobs. Related work: builds on ENG-4207 (onboard prioritization prototype) and PM-119 (release automation goals). Rollout checklist: feature flag, monitor "annotator.confidence < 0.4" alerts, validate generated drafts with curation team for first two weeks.
